testCases.input: What's a good exercise for biceps?
testCases.actualOutput:
Hello! Great question. Building strong biceps is a fantastic goal. Based on our exercise database, here are a couple of excellent strength exercises that specifically target the biceps.

***

### 1. Concentration Curl

This is a classic exercise for isolating the bicep muscle.

*   **Type of activity:** Strength
*   **Equipment:** Dumbbell
*   **Body part:** Upper Body
*   **Muscle group activated:** Biceps
*   **Instructions:** Sit down and curl the dumbbell with your elbow resting on your thigh.
*   **Video Link:** You can see how to perform it here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HgzBZUj0IXI

***

### 2. Drag Curl

This variation is great for hitting the bicep from a different angle.

*   **Type of activity:** Strength
*   **Equipment:** Barbell
*   **Body part:** Upper Body
*   **Muscle group activated:** Biceps
*   **Instructions:** Pull the bar upward against your body, making sure to keep your elbows behind your torso.
*   **Video Link:** Check out the form for this exercise here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H6SRz7GqBFk

Give these a try during your next upper body workout. Let me know if you have any more questions

testCases.input: How do I perform a squat?
testCases.actualOutput:
Hello! As a fitness instructor, I can certainly help you with that. Based on our exercise database, here are a couple of squat variations you can perform.

### Kneeling Squat

*   **Type of activity:** Strength
*   **Equipment:** Barbell/Dumbbell
*   **Body part:** Lower Body
*   **Muscle groups activated:** Glutes, Hamstrings
*   **Instructions:** Start on knees, sit back on heels, thrust hips forward.
*   **Video link:** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gEL84kz77nI

---

### Jump Squats

*   **Type of activity:** Strength
*   **Equipment:** Bodyweight
*   **Body part:** Core
*   **Muscle groups activated:** Quadriceps, Glutes, Hamstrings
*   **Instructions:** Stand straight, curl the weights toward your shoulders and lower them slowly.
*   **Video link:** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=op9kVnSso6Q

Give these a try and let me know if you have any other questions

Exercise: Leg Press
Type of activity: Strength
Equipment: Resistance Band
Body part: Upper body
Exercise type: Push
Muscle groups: Lats, Biceps, Rear Delts
Instructions: Sit on the leg press machine with your back and head flat against the seat pad.

Place your feet shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform, toes slightly angled outward.

Grip the handles for support and disengage the safety locks.

Slowly lower the platform by bending your knees until your legs reach about a 90-degree angle — don’t let your hips lift off the pad.

Press through your heels to extend your legs and return to the starting position, avoiding full knee lockout.

Repeat for the desired number of reps.

*   **Body part:** Lower body
*   **Muscle groups activated:** Hamstrings, Glutes, Lower Back

*   **Type of activity:** Mobility
*   **Equipment:** Barbell
*   **Body part:** Lower body
*   **Muscle groups activated:** Lower Abdominals, Hip Flexors
